 Appearance :

 Mr. Anjum Perveen, Adv.

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Shyameshwar Dayal, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
2 09-12-2024 Heard Mr. Arsad Alam, learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. The petitioner is in custody in connection with Bypass P.S. Case No. 199 of 2024 for the offence punishable under sections 302, 201, 498A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 23.05.2024 by the informant, Babita Devi.

3. As per the prosecution story, the marriage of the daughter of the informant was solemnized in the year 2016 with Ranjit Kumar but was always tortured for dowry and the allegation is that on 23.05.2024, an information came that she has been beaten badly, as they reached the place came to know that she is dead and they are taking the dead body to consign it in flames.
FIR lodged, this followed the arrest.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.83030 of 2024(2) dt.09-12-2024 4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that she is mother in law, has already suffered, lives separately and the husband is in custody since 02.07.2024 which has been brought on record by way of supplementary affidavit.
She is in custody from the date of occurrence i.e. 24.05.2024, if granted bail, she will be diligently appearing in trial.
